user.title: Choose routing mode
user.description: Choose how tools are selected. Recommended: Needle with a model already configured in Home Assistant. The next step shows only the relevant settings.

data_description.backend: In the recommended mode Needle independently approves the model's proposal before Home Assistant can act.

data_description.provider_model: A configured llama.cpp model. Server URL, credentials and model ID are reused automatically from Home Assistant.
data_description.routing_strategy: Both options require independent Needle approval. The existing HA model generates the final tool arguments.
data_description.url: Needle server address for Needle modes; otherwise the OpenAI-compatible server base URL.
data_description.min_confidence: Needle must approve the proposed action at this confidence or higher (default 0.80). Does not apply to direct API calls.
data_description.timeout: Maximum duration of each individual Needle or model request.
data_description.model: Only for the direct OpenAI-compatible API. Leave empty to select the first advertised model.

error.cannot_connect: The configured Needle or model server cannot be reached.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) server URL.
error.no_provider_models: No supported loaded llama.cpp model integration is available.

abort.already_configured: This Needle server is already configured.
